intended_application: packaging of food products with low water content

process_steps.description: Arabinoxylan fraction purified by dia-ultrafiltration, no relaxation cycles

source.quote: The purification by dia-ultrafiltration under permeate flux conditions (at 40 °C, with no relaxation procedure)

process_steps.description: Purified solution concentrated in a rotary evaporator at 17 mbar

source.quote: operated under a controlled pressure of 17 mbar and a bath temperature of 40 °C
the concentrated AX solution was stirred on a hot plate (Velp Scientifica, Usmate, Italy) at 90 °C for 15 min
followed by the addition of glycerol (30% w/w, dry basis)
Ferulic acid was also added at this point up to a final concentration of 10% (w/w dry basis) of ferulic acid equivalents
the film solutions were heated again under stirring for 10 min at 90 °C

process_steps.description: 30 g of solution cast into a 55 mm polystyrene Petri dish

source.quote: a mass of 30 g of each solution was transferred to a 55 mm diameter polystyrene Petri dish
dried at 60 °C for 15 h using a thermal oven
